That's exactly right. I clicked into the title and shortened it right there in the preview, and editing the description the same way — that direct editing feels natural, just what I wanted. And having the site icon next to the name plus the thumbnail off to the left makes the whole thing feel recognizable at a glance.

Adding the imagery only when the page actually offers it makes sense to me too — I wouldn't want a fake or blank picture forced in when there isn't one. This part's good.
